latest.headline: Nvidia down 5% on Huang probe; MU flat ahead of CPI
latest.tldr: Nvidia's board opened an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese spy and the stock is down about 5% pre-market, but the rest of the chip complex is shrugging it off (Taiex +4.9%, Nasdaq 100 futures +0.4%), MU is roughly flat at about $685, and Tuesday's CPI (with December hike odds near 80%) is the bigger event.
